name: Construction Automation ABLR
summary: UK on-site bricklaying robot that lays standard bricks, blocks and mortar for volume housebuilders; NHBC-approved and patented, shown laying bricks on site, not yet on general sale.

germany.statusNote: Not on sale: the UK maker says it is partnering with volume housebuilders, research institutions and supply-chain firms 'to bring the ABLR to market' and offers demonstrations. No German or EU route found.

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: standard bricks, blocks and mortar; no specialist materials
specs.quote: The Automated Bricklaying Robot integrates standard bricks, blocks and mortar — the same materials used on every UK site today.

specs.label: Approval
specs.value: NHBC approved; UK patented, patents filed in 4 territories
specs.conditions: NHBC = UK National House Building Council

specs.label: Team
specs.quote: A seven-strong team working full-time on the ABLR

notes: Works on the building site; running gear, reach and laying rate are not published.
Offers real-time diagnostics, remote support and BIM integration (maker).

evidence.task: Lays standard bricks and mortar on a construction site (maker video 'The ABLR in action')

sources.title: Construction Automation Ltd: the Automated Bricklaying Robot (ABLR)
